# jsQR 1.4.0

Upstream: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR

Browser bundle and LICENSE copied unchanged from the pinned npm package `jsqr@1.4.0` (`https://registry.npmjs.org/jsqr/-/jsqr-1.4.0.tgz`). No install scripts executed. Package SHA512 was verified against npm registry metadata on 2026-10-25:

```text
sha512-dxLob7q65Xg2DvstYkRpkYtmKm2sPJ9oFhrhmudT1dZvNFFTlroai3AWSpLey/w5vMcLBXRgOJsbXpdN9HzU/A==
```

`jsQR-1.4.0.js` SHA256:

```text
bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859
```

Loaded from UTEFit's own `/vendor/jsqr/` endpoint, not a runtime CDN. QR pixels are decoded locally; no image upload/network API is used by the scanner. Preserve the bundled Apache-2.0 LICENSE when redistributing. Future library upgrades must update versioned filename, template reference, integrity test and provenance together.
